resources.string: It\'s the only way to get your Secured account back on a new phone.
Your recovery phrase is 12 words that protect your Secured account. It\'s the only way to get the account back on a new phone.
If you lose your recovery phrase, nobody, including us, can recover your account.
Anyone who has your recovery phrase can open your Secured account. Never share it.
Never type it into a website or send it to anyone. Use it only in Encrogram.
Write the 12 words down on paper, in this order. This screen blocks screenshots on purpose; don\'t photograph it or save the words in a notes app.
These don\'t match the words on the previous screen. Check what you wrote down, or go back to see the words again.
It keeps your Secured account safe. You can show it again under Recovery phrase in the Secured menu.
Type the 12 words of your recovery phrase, in order, separated by spaces.
\"%1$s\" is not in the word list. Check the spelling.
This doesn\'t sign out your old phone. If it was lost or stolen, start a new account instead.
Secured is still starting. Try again in a moment.
This phone already has a Secured account. A recovery phrase can only be used on a phone with no Secured account.
Secured can\'t start right now, so nothing can be restored.
Your Secured account is back on this phone.
Your chats reconnect as your contacts come online.
Very recent messages may not come back.
For now your contacts show as not verified. You can compare security codes with them again whenever you like.
It protects your Secured account and brings it back on any phone.
Without a recovery phrase, losing this phone means losing your Secured account.
Your account was restored on another phone.
Your recovery phrase couldn\'t be kept up to date. Open Secured with a connection and check again later.
This phone is now your active phone
Use your screen lock to show your recovery phrase.
To show your recovery phrase, this phone needs a screen lock (PIN, pattern, password or fingerprint). Set one in Android settings, then try again.
The unlock expired or wasn\'t accepted. Try again.
Your recovery phrase stops working for this account. Your chats on this phone stay as they are. If you save a recovery phrase again later, you get new words.
These 12 words aren\'t valid. Check each word and the order; the last word works as a check, so one wrong word is usually caught.
No Secured account was found for these words. Check them, or the recovery phrase may have been removed.
Unlock your phone with its screen lock first. If this phone has no screen lock, set one in Android settings.
Couldn\'t connect. Check your connection and try again.
